verdict.rationale: Anti-bot proxy handling is a fair axis for a web-scraping service, but the evidence never documents automatic retries or escalation through a chain of different proxies when a request is blocked. The only related item is a vague marketing line about "no proxy headaches", and a community comment says Firecrawl lacks a proxy service. Neither item describes proxy-chain retry behavior, so this is unevidenced rather than disputed.
